THEREALMcCOIL proportional MCMC

Source: R/mccoil_vendor.R
run_mccoil_proportional.Rd

Calls compiled McCOIL_prop and writes its trace and a <output>_summary.txt in the same layout as run_mccoil_categorical(), with rho and pout as extra parameters.

Usage

run_mccoil_proportional(
  dataA1,
  dataA2,
  maxCOI = 25,
  totalrun = 10000,
  burnin = 1000,
  M0 = 1,
  err = 1e-04,
  path = getwd(),
  output = "output.txt"
)

Arguments

dataA1

Allele-1 read counts (samples x sites); negative marks a missing locus.

dataA2

Allele-2 read counts (samples x sites).

maxCOI

Upper bound for COI.

totalrun

Total MCMC iterations.

burnin

Burn-in iterations discarded when summarizing.

M0

Starting COI for every sample.

err

Per-read error rate.

path

Directory for MCMC output files.

output

Base filename for the MCMC trace.

Value

NULL. Called for the files it writes.

Details

Each sample has one set of strain proportions shared by all its loci, and each strain carries one allele per locus. Read noise (rho) and the outlier weight (pout) are estimated. A minor allele below the detection limit, taken as the smallest minor-allele fraction and read count seen in the data, is treated as censored.
